acceptanceCriteria: internal/rubytestprovider calls testevidence.IgnoreRetained (or Retain) and its private function is removed
The existing Ruby cleanliness test still passes
body: PR #1136 (V1-1801) adds internal/testevidence IgnoreRetained and LPCV-V0-084 obliges every provider to use it; PR #1135 (V1-1797) wrote its own private .corvint/.gitignore function in internal/rubytestprovider because the two lanes ran in parallel. Expected: one helper. Actual: two implementations.
title: Ruby test provider should use the shared testevidence retention .gitignore helper (PR #1135 vs PR #1136, LPCV-V0-084)
